Local third-party components in ChickenWing

PDF.js: Apache-2.0; see PDFJS-LICENSE.
SheetJS CE 0.20.3: Apache-2.0; see SHEETJS-LICENSE.
Tesseract.js: Apache-2.0; see tesseract.js/LICENSE.md or LICENSE and bundled distribution notices.
Tesseract.js-core: Apache-2.0; see tesseract.js-core/LICENSE.
English and French OCR data: Tesseract OCR language data, Apache-2.0.

Upstream source URLs are listed in README.md. All browser assets are local.
